# Web members screen, invites and leaving

## What to build

Give web (and desktop, which hosts the web UI) the full team-space membership flow. Space settings for a team space gain a **Members** section listing members and pending invites, an invite form (one or more emails), **Cancel** on pending invites, and for owners a role control and **Remove** per member; everyone sees **Leave space** (also in the sidebar space menu). Add a public `/invite/:token` route that sends signed-out visitors to sign-in and back, then shows the space name with **Join** and **Decline**. Signed-in users with pending invites (`spaces.invites.mine`) see a compact notice in the sidebar with Join/Decline. Add a Playwright e2e spec covering create → invite → accept → member listed → remove, capturing the members screen screenshot.

## API this slice calls (already implemented)

All are oRPC procedures in `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts` under `spaces`, schemas in `packages/contracts/src/space-members.ts`:

| Procedure | Input | Output | Who |
|---|---|---|---|
| `spaces.members.list` | `{ spaceId }` | `{ members: [{ userId, name, email, image, role: "owner" \| "member", joinedAt }], invites: [{ id, email, expiresAt, invitedBy: { userId, name } }] }` | member |
| `spaces.invites.create` | `{ spaceId, emails: string[] (1-10) }` | `{ invites: [...] }` (existing members skipped) | member; `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` on limits; `BAD_REQUEST` for private spaces |
| `spaces.invites.cancel` | `{ inviteId }` | `{}` | member |
| `spaces.invites.mine` | — | `[{ id, spaceId, spaceName, invitedByName, expiresAt }]` | signed-in user |
| `spaces.invites.accept` | `{ token }` or `{ inviteId }` | `{ spaceId }` | invitee; `NOT_FOUND` (bad/used/expired), `FORBIDDEN` (email mismatch or unverified email for id path) |
| `spaces.invites.decline` | `{ token }` or `{ inviteId }` | `{}` | invitee |
| `spaces.members.remove` | `{ spaceId, userId }` | `{}` | owner |
| `spaces.members.setRole` | `{ spaceId, userId, role }` | `{}` | owner; `BAD_REQUEST` when demoting the last owner |
| `spaces.leave` | `{ spaceId }` | `{ activeSpaceId }` | member; `BAD_REQUEST` for last owner or private space |

`SpaceSchema` (`packages/contracts/src/domain.ts`) has `kind: "private" | "team"` and the caller's `role`; `spaces.list` lists spaces across all of the caller's organizations. Invite emails link to `<webOrigin>/invite/<token>`. A removed member's next request with that space header gets 401.


## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/web/src/pages/SpaceSettingsPanel.tsx` (123 lines, `data-testid="space-settings"`): name group, `<SpaceSettingOverrides/>`, Delete button. Insert a Members section between the name group and the overrides, only when `space.kind === "team"`.
- `apps/web/src/pages/SettingsOverlay.tsx` 354-386 — hosts the panel (`section === "space"`).
- `apps/web/src/pages/shell/shell-dialogs.tsx` 207-257 — sidebar space DropdownMenu (`Settings`, destructive `Delete space` gated on `canDelete`); add `Leave space` for team spaces.
- `apps/web/src/pages/Shell.tsx` 763-790 — `renameSpace` / `removeSpace` handlers (after removing the active space: `selectSpace(activeSpaceId)` then `window.location.assign("/app")`); mirror for leave.
- `apps/web/src/pages/shell/dialogs.tsx` 467-497 — `DeleteSpaceDialog`, `DeleteItemDialog` (confirmation pattern for Leave and Remove).
- `apps/web/src/lib/query.ts` and `apps/web/src/lib/space-rpc.tsx` — `useSpaceQueries()`, `useSpaceRpc()`; components use `useQuery(queries.spaces.members.list.queryOptions({ input: { spaceId } }))` and invalidate after mutations (example: `apps/web/src/pages/SpaceSettingOverrides.tsx` 41-43, 95, 103).
- `apps/web/src/lib/rpc.ts` 18-56, 96-129 — space header, `selectSpace`, `leaveUnavailableSpace` (already handles a removed member's 401 by switching to the default space).
- `apps/web/src/App.tsx` 46-68 (lazy pages), 108-116 (`signInDestination` allow-list — add `/invite/`), 183-275 (routes; signed-out redirect like the MCP route at 208-220).
- `apps/web/src/pages/shell/use-space-roster.ts` 84 and `sidebar-roster.tsx` 100-195 — sidebar data; put the incoming-invite notice at the top of the space list, rendered only when `invites.mine` is non-empty.
- `apps/web/src/components/InviteDialog.tsx` — unrelated referral "Invite friends" dialog; **name the new components differently** (e.g. `SpaceMembersSection`, `SpaceInviteForm`, `InviteAcceptPage`).
- UI kit: `packages/ui-web` (shadcn on Base UI: `Button`, `Input`, `Select`/`DropdownMenu`, `AlertDialog`, `Avatar` if present), `SectionHeading` for the section heading, `SettingsGroup`/`SettingsRow` used in SpaceSettingsPanel. Colors only from semantic tokens.
- Tests: `apps/web/src/pages/SpaceSettingsPanel.test.tsx` 1-60 (vitest + jsdom + `createRoot`/`act`, mocks for `@lingui/react/macro` and `@rakazo/ui-web`); e2e `apps/web/e2e/spaces.spec.ts`, helpers `apps/web/e2e/helpers.ts` (`signup` 66, `rpc` 26, `openNewSpace` 184-187, `captureScreenshot` 162-171, `clickAndWaitForRpc` 337); multi-user specs use `browser.newContext` (see `apps/web/e2e/auth-lifecycle.spec.ts`). The e2e harness runs with the email emulator; captured mail is at `GET /api/dev/emails` (array of `{ to, subject, text, html }`).
- `apps/web/playwright.config.ts` — do not add the new spec to `nightlySpecs` (it must run on PRs).

## Copy (keep exactly this minimal; every string must be needed)

- Section heading `Members`; invite field placeholder `Email addresses`; button `Invite`; pending badge `Invited`; per-row actions `Cancel`, `Remove`, role select `Owner` / `Member`; `Leave space`; confirm titles `Remove {name}?` / `Leave {space}?` with buttons `Remove` / `Leave`.
- Invite page: heading `Join team space`, buttons `Join` / `Decline` (no API returns invite details by token, and none should be added); invalid token message `This invite is no longer valid.`
- Sidebar notice: `{space}` with `Join` / `Decline` buttons, no extra sentence.
- Run `pnpm --filter @rakazo/web intl:extract` and fill every `apps/web/src/locales/*/messages.po`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/web/src/pages/SpaceMembersSection.tsx` (+ `.test.tsx`)
- **IMPLEMENT**: list members (avatar, name, email, role) and pending invites; invite form splitting on commas/whitespace/newlines, client-side `type="email"` checks only (server validates); owner-only role select and Remove (hidden for self); Leave for everyone; disable controls while a mutation runs; show server error message inline on failure.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm exec vitest run apps/web/src/pages/SpaceMembersSection.test.tsx`

### UPDATE `SpaceSettingsPanel.tsx`, `shell-dialogs.tsx`, `Shell.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: mount the section for team spaces; add Leave to the sidebar menu; `leaveSpace(spaceId)` handler calling `rpc.spaces.leave`, then `selectSpace(activeSpaceId)` and `window.location.assign("/app")` if it was active, else refresh `spaces.list`.

### CREATE `apps/web/src/pages/InviteAcceptPage.tsx` and route `/invite/:token`
- **IMPLEMENT**: signed-out → `/sign-in?next=/invite/<token>` (add to `signInDestination` allow-list, also after sign-up instead of always `/onboarding` when `next` starts with `/invite/`); signed-in → show the `Join team space` heading with Join/Decline; on `NOT_FOUND` or `FORBIDDEN` from accept/decline show `This invite is no longer valid.` (one generic message, never which case). Join → `spaces.invites.accept({ token })` → `selectSpace(spaceId)` → `/app`. Decline → `/app`.
- **GOTCHA**: never log or send the token anywhere except the accept/decline call; don't put it in analytics.

### UPDATE sidebar (`sidebar-roster.tsx` or `use-space-roster.ts`)
- **IMPLEMENT**: query `spaces.invites.mine`; render notice rows with Join (accept by `inviteId`) and Decline.

### CREATE `apps/web/e2e/team-spaces.spec.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: context A signs up (`signup`), creates a team space via the Create menu (`create-menu-trigger` → `create-new-team-space`), opens its settings, invites `b-<random>@rakazo.test`; context B signs up with that email; fetch `/api/dev/emails` (from A's page request context), extract the `/invite/<token>` link, B visits it and clicks Join, lands in the team space; A's Members section lists B as Member → `captureScreenshot(page, testInfo, "team-space-members")`; A removes B; B's next navigation lands back in B's personal space. Second test: B sees the sidebar notice from `invites.mine` and joins from there.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm test:e2e --spec=team-spaces`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Team space settings show Members with members and pending invites; non-team spaces show nothing new.
- [ ] Members can invite and cancel; owners can change roles and remove; everyone can leave (last owner gets the server error).
- [ ] `/invite/:token` works signed-out (via sign-in/sign-up) and signed-in; bad tokens show one generic message.
- [ ] Pending invites appear in the sidebar with Join/Decline.
- [ ] e2e spec passes and captures `team-space-members`.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm --filter @rakazo/web test
pnpm test:e2e --spec=team-spaces
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
